reasoning: On the season so far the Pelicans are the stronger team; with home court the Pelicans start about 3 points better, in a game of about 235 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Kings.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Pelicans win 56 times in 100, by about 2; most games like this end between 209 and 257 total points.
